title: Aurora Lake
description: A living lake beneath close aurora curtains

title: Prismatic Sanctuary
description: A flowing jewel tunnel beneath a woven particle vault
music_direction: A single cohesive 90 BPM electronic arrangement: rounded low kick, soft offbeat bass, quiet filtered shaker, and sustained warm synth chords. No piano, plucked melody or independently timed backing music.

title: Fractal Garden
description: Infinite branching ferns unfurl around you
music_direction: Organic woodland electroacoustic ambient: breathy bass flute without breath hiss, felt piano isolated low notes, bowed wooden resonance and warm cello harmonics, slowly branching melodies in pentatonic harmony.

title: Tidal Origami
description: Liquid ribbons fold into impossible arches
music_direction: Aquatic ambient: low singing bowls, muted marimba droplets, fluid glass resonances and deep rounded waterlike synth chords. Wide rippling acoustic space, no splash transients, long warm suspended waves.

title: Cloud Atelier
description: Cloud rivers open into a weightless vault
music_direction: Airborne neoclassical ambient: feather-soft muted strings, distant celeste with softened attacks, airy wordless synthesizer pads (strictly no human voices), suspended major ninth chords, slow drifting lightness.

title: Neural Constellation
description: Gentle signals travel through a living web
music_direction: Intimate bioelectronic ambient: rounded warm sine plucks with very slow softened attacks, low velvet viola, tiny distant harmonic echoes that answer irregularly, rich cellular evolving pads. Organic connectedness and stillness.

title: Circuit Garden
description: Soft currents wind through suspended circuits
music_direction: Warm analog electronic ambient: detuned vintage polysynth, soft electric piano, low rounded oscillator resonances, extremely sparse gentle filtered arpeggio fragments with no beat. Electricity as warmth, no buzz, no glitch, no sharp sparks.

title: Pilgrim Tides
description: Small figures gather into flowing constellations
music_direction: Humanist minimalist ambient: delicate felt piano, distant warm chamber strings, soft low clarinet, irregular slow call-and-response motifs, patient communal motion, consonant tender harmony. No marching pulse, no percussion, no vocals.
